name: David Bleakely
quote: The reconstruction of our Athletic Stadium is a profound change for Marlboro High School.  The new stadium will reflect a standard of excellence that both our student-athletes and our coaches represent every day, and that our community deserves.  While the former stadium served this community well for more than 50 years, I am very excited about the opportunities the new stadium will provide for our school community.  I am also deeply grateful to Mayor Hornik and the Marlboro Township government collectively for making this dream into a reality.
